info.description: Single-dispatcher local job archive, nesting-v1 geometry profile. No inventory writes. v1 endpoints remain compatible. No distributed leases, SSE, authentication or multi-material support in this stage. Schema validation is followed by engine and geometry checks. timeLimitSeconds requests cooperative interruption, not guaranteed hard preemption. 一维 slitting-v1 使用独立计算进程；输入单位 mm，卷长分辨率1000 mm。
